ana: Quick follow-up on the hosted/dedicated/private seam tests we ran this morning. Found a case where auth headers are dropped during sidecar handoff.
mike: oh? which path? can you paste sample request?
ana: Repro steps: client -> ingress -> hosted edge -> if capacity low, route to dedicated -> sidecar proxy does header normalize. snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <token>
X-Internal-Trace: abc123
X-Experimental-Flag: true
```
After handoff the `X-Experimental-Flag` is gone.
sophie: Looks like our auth shim strips unknown headers in normalize_headers(). We added that to keep config consistent but it's too aggressive :grimace:
rahul: We intentionally stripped `x-experimental-*` headers. Maybe we should limit to only `x-internal-*`. Tradeoff: exposes more surface vs. dropping telemetry.
mike: Agree. Also raises question about observability: hosted should redact tenant_id when routing to private. We need per-hosting policy in adapter manifest.
nana: Proposed minimal change: adapter manifest field `preserve_headers: [pattern,...]` with default `['x-internal-*']` and allow override on private/dedicated. Example manifest snippet:
```
adapter_manifest: {
  preserve_headers: ["x-internal-*"],
  header_rules: {
    allow_authorization_passthrough: false
  }
}
```
This keeps default safe while letting private envs opt in.
sophie: That seems reasonable. Add validation in controlplane to prevent `Authorization` passthrough unless opt-in.
rahul: Also: fallback behavior when manifest missing. Should hosted accept missing field and use safe default? I'd prefer explicit denylist + whitelist semantics so defaults are conservative.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of header-preserve patch queued for 08:00 PDT :rocket:
mike: Test matrix: (1) hosted->hosted, (2) hosted->dedicated, (3) hosted->private-sidecar. Check header retention, tenant isolation, latency. Add tests to e2e-suite 'routing-seams'. Keep them small and deterministic.
nana: I'll add a checklist and quick PR. We should also log a decision: preserve_headers only enabled for orgs with `private: true` unless security flag explicitly set. +1?
sophie: :thumbsup: also add an audit log entry whenever we pass through any auth-like header.
rahul: I'll draft a short RFC blurb about adapter manifest delta and fallback semantics. Aim to keep surface tiny to avoid long-term tech debt.
nana: Thanks! If no objections I'll open the PR in ~2h and tag eng-ops for review.
mike: No objections from me. Keep tests minimal and reproducible.
